name: Lucy Frostblade
source: Lucy Frostblade didn't have enough screentime for us to assume she and Kristen have bad blood, but surely she wouldn't be happy with someone whose adventuring party killed her adventuring party, even if her own adventuring party killed her first, right? Maybe they can make small talk about that in cleric class.
